title: LEMON SAUCE
instructions: --Grate the rind and squeeze the juice of one lemon. Mix together three teaspoons corn starch, one cup of sugar and two cups of boiling water, and cook ten minutes, stirring constantly. Add the lemon rind and juice and one teaspoon of butter.
